title: Dolly Parton's 5-Ingredient Casserole
ingredients: 3 cups cooked and shredded chicken (a rotisserie chicken works well)
1 (10.5 oz) can cream of chicken soup
1 sleeve butter crackers (such as Ritz), crushed
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F and grease a 9-inch square baking dish with nonstick spray.
Stir together the chicken, cream of chicken soup, and sour cream.
Spread half of the chicken mixture in the baking dish, then top with half of the cheese.
Top with the remaining chicken mixture, followed by the remaining cheese, then the crushed crackers.
Bake until bubbly and the top is golden brown, about 30 minutes. Let rest 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Shared as a Facebook reel from creator 'Drew Eats' titled "I Will Always Love Dolly Parton's 5 Ingredient Casserole." The reel's on-screen captions and comments didn't spell out exact quantities, so the ingredient amounts and steps above are sourced from 12tomatoes.com's published version of this well-known Dolly Parton recipe. Good served over rice or pasta; egg noodles could be mixed in too.
